mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy cycle, reducing discount rates applied to equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during easing periods, or FEDFUNDS shows no sustained decline over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the CPIAUCSL index above 240 signals aggressive monetary tightening, compressing equity valuations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns remain positive despite CPIAUCSL exceeding 240, or the inflation spike is temporary and reversed within the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate and decreases in unemployment rates (UNRATE) indicate a tightening monetary policy cycle, elevating risk premiums and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns are positive despite the tightening indicators, or the policy shift is not sustained over the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime characterized by high INDPRO growth and low FEDFUNDS rates, S&P 500 forward returns are expected to be positive over the next 5 trading days as market anticipates continued growth.
failure_condition: 5-day returns negative despite meeting the late-cycle expansion regime conditions (INDPRO > 105 and FEDFUNDS < 0.25) over the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous surge in both GDPC1 (demand) and RSAFS (demand) proxies signals robust economic growth, boosting corporate earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and RSAFS rise above their 3-month moving averages
failure_condition: 5-day returns negative despite both demand proxies rising, or the growth is not sustained beyond the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in HOUST below 1000 indicates a contraction in business activity, reducing corporate profits and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns remain positive despite HOUST falling below 1000, or the contraction is temporary.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in UNRATE above 4.5% signals weakening labor market conditions, raising recession risks and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns positive despite UNRATE rising above 4.5%, or the unemployment rate stabilizes without a sustained rise.

mechanism_narrative: Rising PAYEMS (labor costs) alongside elevated CPIAUCSL (inflation) indicates stagflationary pressures, tightening financial conditions and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS crosses above 1100 and CPIAUCSL exceeds 240
failure_condition: 60-day returns positive despite high labor costs and inflation, or the inflation spike is not sustained.
